description: This file implements a striped LRU cache with multiple buckets to reduce mutex contention, including methods for cache operations and creation of the cache with configurable bucket count.

classes.name: LRUStriped
classes.description: A lock-free striped LRU cache implementation with multiple buckets to reduce contention.

methods.name: hashkeyMapHash
methods.description: Hashes a string key to a uint64 using xxhash.

methods.name: keyBucket
methods.description: Returns the bucket (LRU cache) corresponding to a given key.

methods.name: Purge
methods.description: Purges all buckets in the striped cache.

methods.name: SetWithDefaultExpiry
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair with default expiry in the appropriate bucket.

methods.name: SetWithExpiry
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair with specified TTL in the appropriate bucket.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a value for a key from the appropriate bucket.

methods.name: GetMulti
methods.description: Retrieves multiple values for given keys.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a key from the appropriate bucket.

methods.name: Scan
methods.description: Iterates over all buckets, applying a function to their keys.

methods.name: Len
methods.description: Returns the total number of items across all buckets.

methods.name: GetInvalidateClusterEvent
methods.description: Returns the cluster event associated with cache invalidation.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the cache.

methods.name: NewLRUStriped
methods.description: Creates a new striped LRU cache with specified options, including number of buckets and size.
